hypotheses.rationale: The consistent meal timing, coffee consumption during work hours, and early morning routine on Day 4 (Friday) strongly suggest a regular work schedule. Weekend patterns (Days 5-6) show maintained meal times but different evening activities (remote control usage), supporting a professional who maintains some structure on weekends but engages in leisure activities.

The presence of remote control usage during evening hours on Day 7 (Monday) suggests possible leisure time during what would typically be work hours, though this is less likely given the strong evidence of regular work patterns.
